defaultRule.d42Title: Names of Iranian sites keep their state
defaultRule.d42Text: A proxy is never used for Iranian names. When a service or rule does not decide such a name, it is let through, whatever you choose here.
defaultRule.changeTitle: This changes where every undecided name goes
defaultRule.changeText: From {from} to {to}. It applies at once to every name that no filter, service or rule decides.

disable.pickFirst: Pick a date and time first.

default_rule.title: Default Rule
default_rule.body: The Default Rule is the last step. A name reaches it only when no custom rule, Geo Rule, service or filter has matched. Bypass lets it through, Block refuses it, and Redirect sends it to a location or an address you choose. Names that are never proxied keep their state, so they are let through even if you choose Redirect.

block_exfiltration.title: Block DNS exfiltration
block_exfiltration.body: Malware can hide stolen data in very long or unusual DNS names. With this on, such queries are blocked before they leave. Normal browsing is not affected.

rebind_protection.title: DNS rebind protection
rebind_protection.body: In a rebind attack a public site is made to resolve to an address inside your home or office network, so a web page can reach your router or devices. With this on, such answers are dropped.

disable_dnssec.title: Disable DNSSEC
disable_dnssec.body: DNSSEC checks that an answer was not changed on the way. A site with broken signatures cannot be opened while the check is on. Turn this on only to reach such a site, and turn it off again afterwards.

block_ttl.title: Block TTL
block_ttl.body: TTL is the time, in seconds, a device may remember an answer. A short Block TTL makes a device ask again soon, so a name you unblock opens sooner. Without a value it is 60 seconds.

redirect_ttl.title: Redirect TTL
redirect_ttl.body: TTL is the time, in seconds, a device may remember an answer. A short Redirect TTL makes a device pick up a changed location sooner. Without a value it is 60 seconds.

bypass_ttl.title: Bypass TTL
bypass_ttl.body: With a value, every answer that passes through is given this TTL, in seconds. Without one, each answer keeps the TTL its own server gave.

block_response.title: Block response
block_response.body: By default a blocked name is answered with 0.0.0.0 for IPv4 and :: for IPv6. NXDOMAIN says the name does not exist, REFUSED refuses the query, and Custom answers with addresses you give. A block page with your own logo and message comes later.

ecs.title: EDNS client subnet (ECS)
ecs.body: With No ECS nothing about your network is sent. Auto sends the first part of your own address. Custom sends the subnet you write, which is useful to get answers for another place.

dns64.title: DNS64
dns64.body: On a network that has only IPv6, a site that has only IPv4 cannot be reached. DNS64 makes an IPv6 address for it that the network translates. It is never applied to blocked or redirected names.

cname_flattening.title: CNAME flattening
cname_flattening.body: Many sites answer with a chain of alias names before the address. With this on, the answer holds only the final address, under the name that was asked. Some devices handle that better.

safe_search.title: Safe search
safe_search.body: Search engines are told to leave out explicit results for every device on this profile. It works for the engines that support it.

restricted_youtube.title: Restricted YouTube
restricted_youtube.body: YouTube hides videos that may be unsuitable. It applies to every device that uses this profile and cannot be turned off from the device.

disable.title: Disable this profile
disable.body: Pick for how long, then turn the switch on. The profile switches itself back on when the time ends, or when you turn the switch off.

lock.title: Lock profile
lock.body: Locking asks for a password that belongs to this profile alone, and an optional message that whoever opens the profile will see. While it is locked, every control is off. Reading, exporting and duplicating stay open.

default_rule.name: Default Rule
default_rule.description: What happens to a name that no filter, service or rule has decided.

block_exfiltration.name: Block DNS exfiltration
block_exfiltration.description: Blocks queries that look like data smuggled out inside DNS names.

rebind_protection.name: DNS rebind protection
rebind_protection.description: Drops answers that point a public name at an address inside your own network.

disable_dnssec.name: Disable DNSSEC
disable_dnssec.description: Skips the signature check, for the rare site whose signatures are broken.

block_ttl.name: Block TTL
block_ttl.description: How long a device keeps the answer for a blocked name.

redirect_ttl.name: Redirect TTL
redirect_ttl.description: How long a device keeps the answer for a redirected name.

bypass_ttl.name: Bypass TTL
bypass_ttl.description: Replaces the TTL of every answer that is let through.

block_response.name: Block response
block_response.description: What a blocked name gets back.

ecs.name: EDNS client subnet (ECS)
ecs.description: Tells the upstream roughly where you are, so it can pick a near server.

dns64.name: DNS64
dns64.description: Gives networks with only IPv6 an address for sites that only have IPv4.

cname_flattening.name: CNAME flattening
cname_flattening.description: Answers with the final address and drops the chain of alias names.

safe_search.name: Safe search
safe_search.description: Removes inappropriate results from the search engines it supports.

restricted_youtube.name: Restricted YouTube
restricted_youtube.description: Turns on YouTube's restricted mode for every device on this profile.

disable.name: Disable this profile
disable.description: Stops filtering for a while. Every name is answered as if the profile had no rules.

lock.name: Lock profile
lock.description: Nothing in the profile can change without the lock password.
